claim: The anchor paper's own approximate decomposition does not support treating EPC alone as accounting for the full reported qDeltaVnr reduction in either representative PA or SMA comparison.

primary_source.citation: Luo et al., Suppressing electron-phonon coupling and energy loss in organic solar cells by modulating donor-acceptor penetrated-interface, Nature Communications 17 (2026)

PA_D18_PYIT.provenance: paper prose; both values explicitly approximate (~)

SMA_D18_eC9.provenance: paper prose; both values explicitly approximate (~)

equations.adversarial_equal_opposite_perturbation: epsilon_star = g/2, where total->total-epsilon and EPC->EPC+epsilon

units: meV for voltage-loss energy qDeltaVnr; fractions dimensionless
uncertainty_statement: The paper marks these values as approximate and does not provide uncertainty for these prose summaries. No physical uncertainty is invented. epsilon_star is an adversarial sensitivity distance, not a confidence interval or measurement uncertainty.
validity_domain: Arithmetic audit of the paper's reported approximate decomposition only. It is not an independent experimental decomposition, does not assume additivity of coupled mechanisms, and does not establish D18/PY-IT/eC9 ternary causal fractions.
falsifier: Primary raw/model outputs showing that the reported EPC-only and total reductions were defined on a different basis that invalidates the ratio comparison, or a corrected version of the paper changing the quoted values/interpretation.
next_physical_discriminator: Prospectively measure B0/B1/B2 field-dependent generation, DeltaVnr/Voc, stabilized Pmax, and independent energetic-offset/reorganization/hybridization observables so EPC is not the sole latent explanatory variable.
